plan.title: Tracker-less projects report reason 'missing_issue_prefix' — the accurate 'tracker_unconfigured' is unreachable because the prefix check runs first
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: Path-only projects (no tracker fields in projects.yaml) report reason 'missing_issue_prefix' from the membership gather, but the accurate declared reason 'tracker_unconfigured' exists and is unreachable because the issue_prefix guard runs before tracker resolution at both gates in src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts (entry gatherProjectLensSignals lines 503-509 and inner listProjectTrackerIssues lines 200-208). The wrong reason misdirects every Flywheel investigate suggestion toward a fix that would not make the project queryable.
narratives.Proposal: Reorder only (issue option 1): call resolveProjectTrackerType(project) before the issue_prefix guard in both gatherProjectLensSignals() and listProjectTrackerIssues(), so tracker-less projects throw tracker_unconfigured while tracker-configured-but-prefix-less projects still throw missing_issue_prefix. Add two unit tests (path-only => tracker_unconfigured; gitlab-without-prefix => missing_issue_prefix) and document the precedence in docs/PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md. Full rationale and before/after snippets in the PRD draft (.pan/drafts/PAN-3217.md).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Returning empty membership for tracker-less projects (issue option 2) — deferred; needs an operator policy decision
- Removing or reconfiguring the papers-please / puzzdom projects.yaml entries — config hygiene, not code
- Changing MEMBERSHIP_UNAVAILABLE_REASONS vocabulary or the /api/pipeline/membership response shape
- Modifying resolveProjectTrackerType, getIssuePrefix, or PipelineMembershipUnavailableError
- Touching other typed-reason classifications (repo_unavailable, forge_unavailable, gather_failed, default_branch_unresolved)

autoDecisions.summary: Chose issue option 1 (reorder checks) over option 2 (empty membership for tracker-less projects)
autoDecisions.rationale: Option 2 changes unavailable→empty semantics and would silently hide genuine misconfiguration; tracker_unconfigured keeps the blind spot visible with an accurate label. Whether path-only registrations are legitimate is operator policy, not a read-door decision. The issue text itself frames option 1 as 'correct if registering path-only projects is not legitimate', and that legitimacy is undecided.

autoDecisions.summary: Reorder at both guard sites, not only the one the issue cites
autoDecisions.rationale: gatherProjectLensSignals() entry guard (lines 503-509) throws missing_issue_prefix before listProjectTrackerIssues() is ever reached, so fixing only the inner function would leave the bug in place. Reordering both is required for the accurate reason to surface.

items.title: Resolve tracker type before the issue_prefix guard in both membership gather gates

expected_outputs: the new 'classifies a tracker-less project as tracker_unconfigured' test passes
the new gitlab-without-prefix missing_issue_prefix test passes
the pre-existing 'classifies a missing GitHub issue prefix' test passes unmodified

narrative.Action: In src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts: (1) in gatherProjectLensSignals() at line 499, insert `resolveProjectTrackerType(project); // throws tracker_unconfigured when no tracker exists` immediately before the issuePrefix guard at lines 503-509; (2) in listProjectTrackerIssues() at line 199, move the existing `const trackerType = resolveProjectTrackerType(project);` from line 208 to above the issuePrefix guard at lines 200-206. Do not modify resolveProjectTrackerType, getIssuePrefix, or the error class. In tests/unit/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.test.ts, next to the existing 'classifies a missing GitHub issue prefix' test at line 584, add two tests using the existing deps() fixture: (a) a path-only project ({ name, path } only) rejects from gatherProjectLensSignals with { reason: 'tracker_unconfigured', message: expect.stringContaining(project name) }; (b) a project with gitlab_repo set and no issue_prefix rejects with reason 'missing_issue_prefix'. The pre-existing GitHub variant test must pass unmodified — it is the FR-2 regression guard.

narrative.Action: In docs/PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md, extend the typed-reasons sentence at line 48 (the one enumerating missing_issue_prefix, repo_unavailable, default_branch_unresolved, forge_unavailable, tracker_unconfigured, gather_failed) with one or two sentences stating the precedence: when several causes apply, tracker resolution is checked first — a project with no tracker reports tracker_unconfigured, while a project with a tracker but no issue_prefix reports missing_issue_prefix. No restructuring of the doc.
